name: Tooltip
description: Delayed hover label presented through the popover machinery, plus the themed TooltipContainer surface and the tooltip overlay handler.

fields.padding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - null = density base gap at 0.75x
fields.textStyle: TextStyle? - its colour is ignored (taken from foreground)
fields.surfaceBlur: double? - null = the app theme's surfaceBlur

notes: `InstantTooltip` is deleted: it was a second copy of `Tooltip` with a zero wait duration. Use `Tooltip(waitDuration: Duration.zero)`.
`FixedTooltipOverlayHandler` is deleted: 142 lines re-implementing `PopoverOverlayHandler.show` with zero readers.

`adaptiveOverlay` is dropped: it reached into the `overlay_configuration` component. An app installs a distinct tooltip handler through `ShadcnLayer(tooltipHandler: ...)` instead, which `TooltipOverlayHandler` routes to.
Overlays capture `InheritedTheme` and `Data` through the popover primitive, so a light -> dark switch while a tooltip is open repaints it.
